mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: concept_note.md 'Training and career development' section; strategic_positioning.md section '2.1 Career perspectives / employability'
mappings.mapping_description: The concept explicitly describes a structured Career Development Plan prepared jointly by supervisor and fellow, submitted as a project deliverable at months 2–3 and reviewed at M12 and M24. Training integrates digital and AI skills (including responsible use of generative AI), knowledge valorisation and innovation/entrepreneurship, and research integrity and open-science ethics. Strategic positioning section 2.1 ('Career perspectives / employability') quantifies career advancement targets: ≥3 peer-reviewed publications (≥2 first-author), ≥120 hours of transferable-skills training, co-supervision of ≥1 MSc thesis, and a follow-on national or ERC-track proposal submitted within six months of fellowship end. These activities directly and explicitly address expanded research and transferable skills leading to improved career prospects within academia and beyond.
